concern_results.conclusion: The new section's three defects, the scenario-testing clause's summary, and the register row's description all name the same three record-layer defects; the section explicitly positions itself relative to the sibling absence-assertion rule rather than contradicting it, and the shown sibling text is preserved.
The candidate adds only Markdown prose under skills/ plus two plain-text evidence files pinning a public commit SHA and ref name; no executable, credential path, or mutation surface is introduced.

The register row is appended at the table tail with the same five-cell shape as sibling rows, its firing-path anchor matches the added bullet's title inside the owner, and observed-failure:no is declared with its rationale rather than silently defaulted.

The RED-baseline label rests on stated paired-walk evidence describing a discriminating held-out harness, and the landed text itself mandates negative-case units (one per absence reason, one extra-attempt, one fail-then-succeed) that would fail a harness exhibiting each named defect.

The change is purely additive: the canonical-list sentence is preserved verbatim and extended, the cross-reference paragraph is untouched, no existing rule text is removed, and no entrypoint file grows.
Rollback is deletion of the added section, the added clause, the appended register row, and the two evidence files; the diff derives no pinned constant or generated artifact from them.

Operational state remains readable through the cited CI run and named gates; the change adds no runtime surface requiring new telemetry, and the register row itself records its evidence basis for later diagnosis.
